name: Masked Hero Unicorn Coaster
description: A chaotic masked anti‑hero riding a glittery unicorn. Bright, silly, and guaranteed to add attitude to any drink.

name: Blue Time Box Coaster
description: A blue time‑travel police box design inspired by classic sci‑fi adventures. Clean, iconic, and instantly recognisable.

name: Monsters Coaster
description: A collage of classic sci‑fi creatures: robots, mutants, stone statues, reptilian warriors, and more. A tribute to decades of alien villains.

name: Silver Android Delete Coaster
description: A sleek silver android face paired with the word 'DELETE.' Minimalist, bold, and ideal for fans of retro sci‑fi robots.

name: SWeeping Statue Coaster
description: A chilling stone statue silhouette with subtle blue‑box accents. Stylish, eerie, and perfect for lovers of time‑travel horror themes.

name: Alien Tank Exterminate Coaster
description: A powerful dome‑shaped alien machine shouting 'EXTERMINATE!' A fun tribute to one of sci‑fi’s most iconic villain archetypes.

name: Brick Hero Coaster
description: A blocky brick‑style caped hero striking a pose. Fun, colourful, and perfect for fans of parody‑style mini‑figure art.

name: Brick Clown Villain Coaster
description: A brick‑style chaotic clown villain with a big grin. Bright, mischievous, and a great match for the hero coaster.

name: Space Wanderer & Green Companion Coaster
description: A lone space wanderer and his tiny green companion in a warm, stylised design. Soft colours and cosy vibes inspired by space‑western adventures.
